successCasesList.disclaimer: All cases are representative of real client outcomes. Client identities are presented using initials and occupation only to protect privacy. All visa results and project completions are verified against RedBridge internal records.

cases.title: Accountant secures 482 sponsorship within 4 months
cases.body: After two years on a 485 with no success applying independently, RedBridge matched her to a 482-eligible accounting firm. With CAANZ already complete, visa grant took under 4 months.

cases.title: Marketing manager on employer-sponsored pathway to 186 PR
cases.body: Client had an existing employer but no formal sponsorship. RedBridge lodged the SBS and 482 nomination concurrently. Now 18 months into a 482 and on track for 186 ENS transition.

cases.title: IT engineer achieves permanent residency via 189 in 7 months
cases.body: With a strong score and completed ACS assessment, the client's barrier was EOI strategy. RedBridge provided a points gap analysis and skills assessment support — an invitation arrived within 7 months.

cases.title: Engineering graduate builds ANZSCO-aligned experience for migration
cases.body: Fresh out of university with no local work history, this client joined the Career Launch Program and accumulated 400+ hours of ANZSCO-aligned project work recognised by Engineers Australia over 12 months.

cases.title: ICT specialist transitions from 485 to employer-sponsored 482
cases.body: With 8 months left on his 485, RedBridge matched him with a Melbourne tech employer and lodged the nomination with a Bridging Visa A in place. The 482 was granted before the 485 expired.

cases.title: International student uses marketing career to build 190 nomination pathway
cases.body: Consulting RedBridge while completing her marketing master's, this client was guided onto Victoria's 190 nomination pathway. A 24-month AMI-aligned career plan was designed and the invitation arrived on schedule.
